limitations: All enhancements were specified after inspecting the original results; original freezes remain unchanged.
CP/Bonferroni intervals are conservative and depend on binomial marginal sampling assumptions; two separately defined families are not a joint 95% family.
Computational-batch resampling is a sensitivity analysis, not proof of within-batch dependence or a more correct randomized-cluster sampling model.
Percentile bootstrap is degenerate at observed boundaries and cannot replace nonzero binomial uncertainty limits.
Time and checkpoint differences are posthoc exploratory contrasts for fixed conditions; different checkpoints confound size, training and family.
Invalid sensitivity permits hypothetical binary assignments; invalid outputs need not possess a well-defined hidden action.
Four bundled text profiles do not isolate individual personality traits or represent real students.

method_plan.action_composition: All 7 valid actions plus invalid; counts and completed/valid denominators by run/profile/arm/level. Overview heatmap uses peer arm only and pools 3 equally sampled peer levels (90 completed per profile/run), explicitly descriptive.

batch_bootstrap.interpretation: Sensitivity to the computational grouping. Shared PRNG does not itself establish within-batch correlation or make batches a superior statistical sampling unit. Not a population or randomized-cluster inference.
batch_bootstrap.sampling: resample the observed number of batches with replacement, include all rows of selected batches; independent resampling streams across runs
batch_bootstrap.undefined: retain and report count of undefined replicates, never substitute zero
batch_bootstrap.unit: observed computational batch_index within each run

method_plan.disclosure: Original formal outcomes have already been inspected. This is not a retrospective preregistration; original scientific/execution freezes and all original analyses remain unchanged.

exploratory_only.model: Qwen2.5-7B 11:00 minus Qwen3-4B 11:00; per-dose changes and difference of high-low peer responses, 4 fixed profiles only
exploratory_only.scope: Only these two fixed checkpoints and these fixed contexts; no checkpoint-size, reasoning-capability, or student-population causal claim. No new model calls.
exploratory_only.time: Qwen3 16:00 minus Qwen3 11:00; per-dose changes and difference of high-low peer responses, 4 fixed profiles only

method_plan.implementation: stdlib finite-binomial-tail inversion for CP (n=30 endpoints); numpy/matplotlib only for visualization; no scipy/statsmodels runtime requirement.

invalid_sensitivity.additional: CP/Bonferroni sensitivity envelope uses lower CP bound at valid-target count and upper CP bound at valid-target+invalid count. This is a hypothetical binary-outcome assignment sensitivity, not proof that invalid outputs possess a true latent action.
retained: valid-only estimate and original Newcombe interval
completed-data worst-case target assignment identification range

multiplicity.coverage: At least 95% simultaneous coverage within each separately defined family under binomial marginal sampling assumptions. Two families are not jointly a single 95% family; exact endpoint construction is conservative.
multiplicity.method: Clopper-Pearson exact binomial endpoint intervals; Bonferroni allocation across all endpoints of each complete family; difference interval [L_A-U_B,U_A-L_B].
